主要内容: TG Therapeutics, Inc. shared an update on its UNITY-CLL Phase 3 study during a webcast on January 27, 2022. The company noted that the updated Overall Survival (OS) results showed improvement from preliminary data shared with the FDA on November 30, 2021. The OS hazard ratio was 1.23 initially, and after censoring for COVID-19 related deaths, it was 1.04. An OS hazard ratio above 1.00 implies potential harm from the investigational therapy. The FDA imposed a partial clinical hold on select studies of U2 and its components for chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) and non-Hodgkin's lymphoma (NHL). The company reported that neither the original preliminary results nor the updated preliminary results were statistically significant, and the results are expected to change over time as more events occur. The partial clinical hold was not based on any new information provided to the FDA but appears to be based on the same data and concerns that gave rise to the previously announced Oncologic Drug Advisory Committee (ODAC) meeting, set to take place in the March/April 2022 timeframe.
